data.one_liner: Use Apple's SF Symbols on iOS and macOS in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget that renders Apple's SF Symbols on iOS and macOS using native pixel buffers and textures. Supports rendering modes, variable values, scale, accessibility labels, caching, and symbol animations.
use_when: Building an iOS or macOS app in Flutter that requires native SF Symbols
Needing animated SF Symbol effects like bounce, pulse, or variable color
avoid_when: Targeting Android, Windows, or web platforms where SF Symbols are unsupported
Needing a cross-platform icon set that works identically across all operating systems
strengths: Native SF Symbols support with full access to weights, scales, and rendering modes
Supports symbol animations and variable values on supported OS versions
Efficient texture sharing and precaching for lists and repeated icons
weaknesses: Limited to iOS and macOS; draws nothing on other platforms
Requires recent OS versions for advanced effects (iOS 17+ / macOS 14+)
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 15.0+ or macOS 12.0+ and Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods.

alternatives.name: cupertino_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a cross-platform set of Cupertino-style icons that work on Android and web as well as Apple platforms.

data.minimal_example:
SfSymbol(
    name: 'camera.aperture',
    weight: FontWeight.w900,
    color: Colors.pink,
    size: 40,
)
